observation: Original hero is a full-width saturated blue block (~680px tall) with an animated network/constellation pattern, likely canvas-driven; AI-built hero sits on the pale grey-blue page background (rgb(247,248,252)) with no decorative pattern and no animation, ending around y≈425.

Both pages have a single centered H1 in the hero. Original sets it in white uppercase Montserrat at 32px/600 ('INSTANTLY ANALYZE YOUR SEO ISSUES') on blue; AI-built sets it in dark navy system-ui at 51.2px/700 in sentence case ('Get an instant analysis of your SEO problems').
The AI-built H1 highlights the phrase 'your SEO problems' with an em rendered in the accent blue; the original H1 has no highlighted phrase.
Tagline under the H1: original uses an italic Lora serif h2 in Title Case (22px/500); AI-built uses a two-line grey sans-serif paragraph about 620px wide.

Hero action: original has a single URL input form with a flat square-cornered green 'REVIEW' button (rgb(105,203,149), radius 0, with a search icon); AI-built has no input and instead shows two anchor CTAs, a solid blue 'Analyze your site' (rgb(56,86,224), 8px radius, 12px 24px padding) and an outlined blue ghost button (0 button elements).

Both pages show sample links to h-supertools, booksandmore and L-ink under the hero action. Original shows them as small, low-contrast blue text links on the blue hero; AI-built shows them as pill-shaped chips beside a small blue letter-spaced 'REVIEW' label.

Both headers have a 'Seo Analyzer' wordmark, Home and Site vs Site links, and an EN language control on the right. Original places them on the blue hero with a white leaf logo and globe icon; AI-built uses a slim 61px white bar with a two-colour wordmark ('Seo' navy, 'Analyzer' blue) and a bordered EN chip.

Both have a three-column feature row (Unlimited Analysis, In-Depth Reviews, Competitive Analysis). Original puts centered columns with no cards on a pale grey band; AI-built uses equal white bordered cards (333x244) with left-aligned text, introduced by a 'Features' h2 and subtitle.

Feature icons: original uses blue FontAwesome glyphs (chart, server, thumbs up) in white circular badges; AI-built uses emoji or symbols (∞, 🔍, ⚖) in 40x40 grey-lavender rounded-square tiles. Neither uses SVG.

Body text: original is 14px/24px Helvetica Neue in dark grey rgb(51,51,51), centered in the features; AI-built is 16px/25.6px system-ui in navy rgb(27,32,51), with grey rgb(91,99,121) secondary text, mostly left-aligned.

The section header for recent sites differs. Original uses a bar with a darker blue label block holding a leaf icon and 'Recently Listed' (h4), plus a small cyan 'View More →' button on the right. AI-built uses a bold 'Recently listed sites' h2 with a grey subtitle and puts a centered outlined 'View More' button below the grid.

Both pages show recently listed sites as a 3-column, 2-row grid of cards. Each card has a 600x450 screenshot, a domain name and stats. Original cards have a thin border and padding around the image, with blue link-style names below. AI-built cards are bordered, rounded article elements with the image flush to the top edge and the domain as a bold h3 link.

Both cards end with three stats: Score N/100, Global Rank and Page Speed %. Each shows a bold value with a small label. Original uses an inline strip with uppercase labels; AI-built uses separate light-grey rounded tiles (rgb(227,230,240)) with sentence-case labels built from b and small elements.
AI-built colour-codes score values (green, amber, red); original shows score values without status colouring.
Both pages show zero-value stats such as 'Global rank 0' and 'Page speed 0%', rendered the same way as real values.

Card alignment: on the original, long domain names wrap and push the stat strips out of line, so cards in a row have unequal heights. AI-built cards are a fixed 333x392 with names that fit, so they stay aligned.

The portal.oouagoiwoye.edu.ng card has no preview. On the original, a broken image icon shows its alt text in a 215x32 box. AI-built uses a full-size 331x249 lavender placeholder div reading 'No preview' (5 images versus 6).
Both pages show uncontrolled third-party site screenshots that vary widely, including a captcha, a black page with raw links, a washed-out truck photo and faded thumbnails.
Both pages have images with alt text and no missing alts. Original alts equal the domain names; AI-built alts follow 'Screenshot of <domain>'.

Footer: original has a dark slate-blue (rgb(60,71,100)) three-column block (About Us, Contact Info, Navigation) with uppercase white h2 titles, short underlines and vertical dividers. AI-built has a slim footer on the pale page background with only copyright text on the left and social icons on the right.

About us and Contact are separate content sections in the AI-built page, each with an h2 in a full-width band. About us is a 720px-measure left-aligned paragraph on white, and Contact is a dt/dd description list. In the original, these appear as footer columns.

Social icons: original uses green FontAwesome glyphs (Facebook, Twitter, Google+, LinkedIn) inside rotated-square diamond outlines; AI-built uses four 32px circular spans with text letters (f, t, in, ig).

Contact info shows the address 'SE Lawnfield Rd' and the email support@h-educate.com. Original shows them with green icons and an orphan phone icon with no number. AI-built shows them as labelled Address and Email rows, with the email as an underlined blue link.

Both pages credit the copyright to H-educate in 2020, which differs from the Seo Analyzer brand ('Copyright © 2020. H-educate All rights reserved.' versus 'Copyright © 2020, H-educate. All rights reserved.').

Palette: original uses several accents (saturated blue, mint green, cyan, slate navy, social green rgb(58,195,65)) on white or light grey, with Bootstrap link blue rgb(51,122,183). AI-built uses a single royal-blue accent rgb(56,86,224) on a near-white blue-grey background with navy text, and amber, green and red only for scores.

Font families: original mixes Helvetica Neue, Open Sans, Montserrat and Lora, plus FontAwesome and Glyphicons icon fonts. AI-built uses only the system-ui stack, with hierarchy from size and weight (h1 51.2px, h2 28.8px/700 against the original's h2 22px/500).

Corner rounding: original is almost entirely square (274 at 0, 16 at 1–7px, none at 8px or more, 3 pill, and a 0px-radius primary button). AI-built rounds cards, tiles and buttons at 8–15px (33 elements) and uses 7 pills.
Neither page uses gradients or backdrop blur. Original has 4 box shadows, 66 transitions, 1 animation and 8 transforms. AI-built has 0 shadows, transitions, animations and transforms.

Layout technique and width: original uses floats or a Bootstrap-style grid (0 grid, 0 flex) with content about 1140px wide (x 150–1290). AI-built uses CSS grid on 17 elements and flex on 6, in a 1040px column (x 200–1240). Both are on a 1440px canvas.
Semantic markup: original is div-heavy (92 divs) with no header, main or article, 1 section, 2 navs and 1 footer. AI-built has header, nav, main, 4 sections, 6 articles and a footer, with 51 divs.
Heading outline: original has h1, then h2, then h4s that skip h3, with footer h2s and an empty h4. AI-built has h1, 4 h2s and 9 h3s in order. Both have one H1 and four H2s.
Page size and copy length: original has about 204 words and is 2399px tall; AI-built has about 258 words and is 2646px tall. Neither uses exclamation marks or em dashes.

Head metadata: original has description, keywords, author and og: tags, with no lang attribute and the title 'Seo Analyzer'. AI-built has only charset, viewport and description, with lang 'en' and the title 'Seo Analyzer – Instant analysis of your SEO problems'. Neither has JSON-LD.
Resource loading: original loads 15 scripts and 8 stylesheets and has 24 inline style attributes. AI-built has 1 script, 0 external stylesheets, a single style block and 2 inline style attributes.

Both use semantic or bespoke class names rather than utility classes (Tailwind-like fraction 0.008 versus 0.028). The vocabulary differs in size: 111 unique classes from 250 uses on the original, 28 from 71 on AI-built.
The original DOM includes 3 forms (the hero search plus hidden sign-in and sign-up forms) with 11 inputs and 8 buttons. AI-built has no forms, inputs or button elements.

Text case: original uses uppercase for the H1, section and footer headings and card labels, and Title Case for the tagline and features. AI-built uses sentence case for headings and labels, apart from the small caps 'REVIEW' label.
Navigation is minimal on both: header links Home and Site vs Site. The original adds a footer Navigation column with a single HOME link; the AI-built footer has no navigation links.
Both pages use generous vertical whitespace between full-width bands that alternate white and grey backgrounds, separated by thin rules.
Alignment: original centers the hero and the feature text. AI-built centers only the hero and left-aligns headings and body in the sections below.
Copy voice: the AI-built page uses short feature-and-benefit marketing text with generic claims such as 'thousands of small-business owners'.
ARIA usage is light on both pages: 7 attributes on the original and 6 on AI-built.
